Name: Animated Festive Winter Tree
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HnJnRKU.png[/img]

I've always loved how Animal Crossing's trees change before Dec. 25th and have wanted to bring that to SDV for some time but didn't have the ability. Now thanks to Space's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿ I can!

config options:

WinterTreeTimeFrame
[list]
[*]BeforeFeast
[*]AllWinter
[/list]
RecolorVersion
[list]
[*]vanilla
[*]eemie
[*]whittlynamedrecolor
[*]starblue
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Install Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿. 
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Remove [CP] Animated Festive Winter Tree from your /Mods folder

[/list]
Thanks to [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/38816245-acerbicon/]acerbicon[/url] for allowing me to use their winter tree in this mod!
